plan.question: How are fractional outputs quantized, and where does positive clipping begin?
hypotheses: H1: Multiply by 1.25, floor, then clip.
H2: Multiply by 1.25, round to nearest with ties to even, then clip; disfavored by existing +17 evidence.
H3: Multiply by 1.25, round half upward, then clip; disfavored by existing +17 evidence.
predictions: H1 clips every input >=204 to 255; supplied patches 223 through 255 must all become 255. Alpha stays 255.
plan.usefulness: Tests fresh quarter-step and tie cases, low values and highlight clipping. Require exact neutral roundtrip; all non-brightness controls stay 0.
